test: M9 (handoff docs/handoff/2026-09-29-mac-m2-handoff.md): the cost of the 2D lighting on the Apple M2, as an A/B of the GPU frame span (user decision 2026-09-30)
label: Apple M2 Pro (16-core GPU) / Metal, Chrome 154.0.8037.58

method.measure: getGpuFrameTiming().averageMs, the frame span (first measured pass beginning to last end) over a clean 120-frame window; per-pass getGpuTimings() entries are intervals and only context
method.cost: span(L48) - span(OFF), adjacent pair per round; shadow-step effect span(L48) - span(L24) as % of span(L48)
method.leavingL24: setQuality({ shadowSteps: 48 }) first (window 5 and control c1, c4, c8)
method.liveSignal: all of: renderer.graph.executionOrder (the LIVE graph, RenderGraphHost.graph) contains 'light-groups' iff lit; renderer.lightingEnabled (the requested mode) matches; lighting.backend (read back from WASM) matches; lighting._needsRebuild false (the quality was handed to the renderer, hyperion.ts tick) and lighting.quality.shadowSteps matches. Then 30 requestAnimationFrame frames of settling, then disableGpuProfiling(); enableGpuProfiling() (profiler reset).
method.window: polled in requestAnimationFrame until getGpuFrameTiming().sampleCount >= 120 (timeout 20 s); then, in one synchronous turn: frameTiming, getGpuTimings(), the profiler window spans (profiler.window.spans: the 120 frames the mean is over), discardReasons, skippedFrames. fps from the requestAnimationFrame timestamps of the window.
method.discards: engine.renderer.graph.profiler.discardReasons read before the reset, right after it (atReset) and after the window; discardDelta = after - atReset (a reset drops the frames in flight without counting them)
method.lightPhase: the Lighting demo animates its point light (orbit, ~10.5 s) and its spot (sweep, ~15.7 s): each window records their pose at reset and at fill (lightsAtReset, lightsAtFill; point = range 12, spot = range 18)
